props.title: The Leaf That Crossed Oceans
props.subtitle: How tea shaped trade, empire and the morning cup

scenes.narration: It began as a bitter medicine in southern China, thousands of years ago.

props.caption: By the 1600s, tea was arriving in Europe by the shipload.

scenes.narration: Within centuries it spread along the caravan routes, and by the sixteen hundreds it reached Europe by ship.

props.text: A single leaf would redraw the map of the world

scenes.narration: And that single leaf would go on to redraw the map of the world.

props.quote: Thank God for tea! What would the world do without tea?
props.author: Sydney Smith

scenes.narration: As one essayist put it: thank God for tea. What would the world do without it?
Next time, the great tea clipper races.
